spans.s: दीप् vi. 4Ā (pp. दीप्त; pres. दीप्यते; freq. देदीप्यते) 1. To blaze, to shine, सर्वैरुस्रैः समग्रस्त्वमिव नृपगुणैर्दीप्यते सप्तसप्तिः Mal.ii.; 2. to burn, e.g. यश्चायं मम लांगूले दाप्यते हव्यवाहनः; 3. to be illustrious; 4. to be inflamed or excited, R.v.47, Bt.xv.88.(The root is used with प्र-, सम्- &c. without any material change in meaning.)
दीप् Caus. (दीपयति-ते) to kindle.With उद्-, to rouse, to excite.
दीप m. A light, a lamp, निशीथदीपाः सहसा हतत्विषः R.iii.15.
दीप-अन्विता f. the day of new moon (अमा).
दीप-आराधन n. worshipping an idol by waving a light before it.
दीप-आलि, -आवलि ऋ।, -उत्सव म्। f. 1. nocturnal illumination; 2. lamp-festival held on the day of new moon Āśvina.
दीप-आलि, -आवलि ऋ।, -उत्सव म्। f. 1. nocturnal illumination; 2. lamp-festival held on the day of new moon Āśvina.
दीप-उत्सव m. 1. nocturnal illumination; 2. lamp-festival held on the day of new moon Āśvina.
दीप-कलिका f. the flame of a lamp.
दीप-किट्ट n. lampblack.
दीप-कूपी, -खोरी f. the wick of a lamp.
दीप-कूपी, -खोरी f. the wick of a lamp.
दीप-ध्वज m. lamp-black.
दीप-पादप, -वृक्ष f. a lamp-stick, a lamp-stand.
दीप-पादप, -वृक्ष f. a lamp-stick, a lamp-stand.
दीप-पुष्प m. the champaka tree.
दीप-भाजन f. a lamp, R.xix.51.
दीप-माला f. an illumination.
दीप-शत्रु f. a moth.
दीप-शिखा f. the flame of a lamp.
दीप-शृंखला f. a row of lights, illumination.
दीपक (I) a. (f. पिका) 1. Kindling; 2. illuminating, illustrating; 3. exciting, stimulating, e.g. पाचनदीपक.
दीपक (II) m. 1. A light, a lamp, तावदेव कृतिनामपि स्फुरत्येष निर्मलविवेकदीपकः Bhartr.i.56; 2. the crest of a peacock; 3. a falcon; 4. an epithet of Kāmadeva. (Also दीप्यक.)

दीपक (III) n. 1. Saffron; 2. a figure of speech consisting in the combination of several objects having the same attribute (some relevant and some irrelevant) or in the combination of several attributes of the same object (some of them relevant and some irrelevant) (सकृद्वृत्तिस्तु धर्मस्य प्रकृताप्रकृतात्मनाम् । सैव क्रियासु बह्वीषु कारकस्येति दीपकम् K.Pr.x.)
दीपक (I) a. (f. पिका) 1. Kindling; 2. illuminating, illustrating; 3. exciting, stimulating, e.g. पाचनदीपक.
दीपिका f. A light, a torch, R.iv.45, ix.70.
दीपन n. 1. Kindling, illuminating; 2. promoting digestion; 3. exciting, stimulating; 4. saffron.
दीपित a. (f. ता) 1. Set on fire; 2. illuminated; 3. manifested.
दीपित a. (f. ता) 1. Set on fire; 2. illuminated; 3. manifested.
दीप्त (I) a. (f. प्ता) 1. Lighted, kindled; 2. illuminated; 3. excited, stimulated, (pp. of दीप् q.v.).
दीप्त (II) m. 1. A lion; 2. the citron tree.
दीप्त (III) n. Gold.
दीप्त (I) a. (f. प्ता) 1. Lighted, kindled; 2. illuminated; 3. excited, stimulated, (pp. of दीप् q.v.).
दीप्त-अंशु m. the sun.
दीप्त-अक्ष m. a cat.
दीप्त-अग्नि m. an epithet of Agastya.
दीप्त-अंग m. a peacock.
दीप्त-आत्मन् a. having a fiery nature.
दीप्त-उपल m. the sun-gem.
दीप्त-किरण m. the sun.
दीप्त-कीर्ति m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
दीप्त-जिह्वा f. a vixen.
दीप्त-तपस् a. fervent in devotion, of glowing piety.
दीप्त-लोह m. brass, bell-metal.
दीप्ति f. 1. Brightness, splendour, lustre; 2. brilliancy of beauty, extreme loveliness; (for the difference between दीप्ति and कांति, See under कांति); 3. lac; 4. brass.
दीप्र (I) a. (f. प्रा) Shining, brilliant, radiant.
दीप्र (II) m. Fire.
दीप्र (I) a. (f. प्रा) Shining, brilliant, radiant.
